native_goal_metric: native success at any step; final and sustained-last-ten endpoints are separate
input_contract: 39-dimensional native state with explicit goal; no images or human video
embodiment: native single Sawyer arm and gripper
generalization_scope: held-out initial states within the same native tasks/assets; not held-out tasks, objects, language or human-video generalization
method_scope: Task-specific state BC models and development controls; not generalist VLA baselines

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap over shared reset-seed blocks, conditional on the fixed 50 native tasks
uncertainty.limitation: Only five reset-seed blocks; intervals are descriptive and do not establish population-level or task-family generalization. Degenerate all-equal block outcomes receive null intervals, not a false zero-width confidence claim.

validation.general_evaluator_validity: native predicates retained; only reach/window have separate geometric agreement checks, not all process or stability requirements
